title: repro run says which claude binary its instances start, so a PATH wrapper cannot add settings unseen
goal: bench_repro.claude_path() returns the resolved path of the claude command the instances start and a problem text when it is a script and not the claude binary (a wrapper first on PATH), empty otherwise; repro run and run --dry-run print claude: <path> and refuse on a problem, so the instances' --settings stays exactly the recorded value; repro run refuses while repro_bench.csv or repro_briefs.csv differs from HEAD, and run.json records their sha256 (BG-vry4snnm)

run:
import os,stat,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b
if not hasattr(b,'claude_path'): print('no claude_path yet');sys.exit(1)
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();f=os.path.join(d,'claude')
open(f,'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexec true\n');os.chmod(f,0o755);os.environ['PATH']=d+os.pathsep+os.environ['PATH']
p,why=b.claude_path();print(p,why);sys.exit(0 if os.path.realpath(p)==os.path.realpath(f) and why else 1)
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import inspect,bench_repro as b;s=inspect.getsource(b.run_problems);sys.exit(0 if ('status' in s or 'ls-files' in s or 'diff' in s) else 1)
import inspect,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b;s=inspect.getsource(b.run);sys.exit(0 if 'file_sha256' in s or 'sha256' in s else 1)

clauses.clause: bench_repro.claude_path() returns the resolved path of the claude command the instances start and a problem text when it is a script and not the claude binary (a wrapper first on PATH), empty otherwise
repro run and run --dry-run print claude: <path> and refuse on a problem, so the instances' --settings stays exactly the recorded value
repro run refuses while repro_bench.csv or repro_briefs.csv differs from HEAD
